scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Sammaan Pension Yojana
other_conditions: Must have at least 40% disability (including blindness, shortsightedness, locomotor disability, leprosy‑free, hearing loss, mental retardation, mental illness, dwarfism, or eunuch)
Dwarfism with height less than 3 feet 6 inches
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 for beneficiaries 75 years or less, ₹1,250 for those 75 years or more, with higher amounts for leprosy‑free patients (₹2,500) and silicosis patients (₹1,500).
